conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Shweta Singh. Mera account ka nominee kaise add karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Shweta ji, main aapko guide karta hoon. Kya aap apna account number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai. Nominee add karne ke liye aapko branch mein form submit karna hoga ya online banking se request daal sakti hain. Main aapko process aur documents ke details mail karta hoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Online ho sakta hai toh better hai. Kitna time lagega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Online request 3-5 din mein process ho jayegi. Koi aur madad?
